question: Can one outcome-free construction-specific scalar gain make the direction-preserving A1/A2 final-state payload interchange quantitatively reusable?

prior_art.known_lessons: Unscaled swaps preserve direction/cosine but systematically overshoot A1 and undershoot A2. Optimizing held logits would memorize the task; the gain must be estimated without outcomes and frozen across parity.
prior_art.novelty: Use only opposite-parity projected state norms to calibrate whole-payload interchange, preserving basis gauge and never optimizing task logits.

frozen_design.fit: For each held fold and each live/frozen suffix variant, compute the mean L2 norm of complete final projected payloads on opposite-parity A1 and A2 rows. Set gain(destination<-source)=mean_norm(destination)/mean_norm(source); the two gains must be reciprocal.
frozen_design.evaluation: On held rows exchange whole A1/A2 payloads as before, multiply only by the frozen destination/source gain, add to the off final state, and decode through the exact final head. P/C remain off. Open no training logits or outcomes.
frozen_design.controls: Require authority, exact rank-two geometry, disjoint parity, finite positive gains, reciprocal closure, final-head replay, exact row pairing, P/C invariance, and literal price. Preserve the unscaled result as comparator.

predictions.pred_a_authority_geometry_crossfit_finit: All hashes, rank-two geometry, disjoint fit/evaluation rows, exact decoding, pairing, finite metrics, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_construction_gains_are_stable_and: Every gain is positive, reciprocal within 1e-6, and the same directed gain differs by <=20% across held folds.
predictions.pred_c_calibrated_swap_preserves_both_co: Calibrated swaps have signed projection in [0.75,1.25], cosine >=0.95, and direction fraction >=0.875 on A1/A2 in both folds and both suffix variants.
predictions.pred_d_calibration_improves_unscaled_amp: For every cell, absolute signed-projection error from 1 is strictly smaller than the preserved unscaled swap error.
predictions.pred_e_calibrated_swap_is_control_select: P/C remain exactly off with zero flips and mean KL <=0.02.

decision: A/B/C/D/E identifies a shared construction payload with one scalar gain per direction. Failure of B or C means the A1/A2 payloads are not reusable by a simple gain and remain operationally split. No held-logit tuning or widened gain grid is allowed.
